<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/posts/{postId}/interactions"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



A generic, per-user action whose meaning depends on the post's
`type` — poll voting, trip check-ins, and album photo contributions
today, more later as new types are registered. `key`/`value` are
opaque here; the post's own type decides what's valid. This endpoint
itself emits no notification — a handler that wants one sends it
itself (a trip check-in and an album contribution both do, see below).

For a `POLL` post: `key: "vote"`, `value: { optionId }`. Voting your
current option again **removes** your vote (unvote); voting a
different option **switches** it. Votes are public to group members
(not anonymous) and results are visible whether or not you've voted.
Voting after `closesAt` has passed is rejected.

For an `EVENT` post: `key: "rsvp"`, `value` one of `"yes"`, `"maybe"`
or `"no"` (a plain string). Sending your current answer again
**clears** it; a different answer **switches** it. RSVPs are public
to the post's audience. Answering is rejected once `rsvpDeadline` has
passed, or once the event has started if no deadline was set. On a cross-posted event you have one answer per event,
not per family: answering on one copy replaces an answer you left on
another.

For a `TRIP` post, three keys are supported. A cross-posted trip
stays one journal — each of these applies to every sibling group's
copy, not just the one addressed by `postId`:

- `key: "checkin"`, `value: { place, text?, photoUrls? }` — adds a
  journal entry (`place` 1-80 chars, `text` up to 2000 chars,
  `photoUrls` up to 10 uploaded `/uploads/...` paths). Only the
  trip's author or one of its `travelerUserIds` may check in, and
  only while the trip is open and has started (a check-in before
  `startDate` is rejected). On a cross-posted trip the entry is
  stored as one comment copy per sibling post, all sharing the same
  `metadata.checkinId` (see `Comment`) — but only in sibling groups
  the check-in author is still a member of at that moment; the
  author editing or deleting one copy edits/deletes them all. Notifies the rest of each group with a push-only
  `trip_checkin` notification — same-day check-ins from the same
  author are bundled into one, and a member of several sibling
  groups is notified exactly once.
- `key: "close"`, no `value` — closes the trip early, on every
  sibling copy atomically. Author only, and only once (a trip also
  auto-closes once its `endDate` has fully elapsed).
- `key: "setTravelers"`, `value: { userIds }` — replaces the trip's
  co-traveler list wholesale (up to 20 ids; the author is always an
  implicit traveler) on every sibling copy atomically. Author only,
  and only while the trip is open; every id must be a current member
  of every sibling group.

For an `ALBUM` post, two keys are supported (a cross-posted album stays
one album — each applies to every sibling group's copy):

- `key: "addPhotos"`, `value: { photoUrls, caption? }` — adds photos
  to the album (`photoUrls` 1-10 uploaded `/uploads/...` paths,
  `caption` up to 2000 chars). Allowed for **any** member of the
  post's group, not just the author, and only while the album is
  open. Stored as one contribution comment per sibling post (sharing a
  `metadata.contributionId`, see `Comment`), only in sibling groups the
  contributor is still a member of. Notifies the rest of each group
  with a push-only `album_photo` notification — same-day contributions
  from the same author are bundled into one.
- `key: "close"`, no `value` — closes the album on every sibling copy
  atomically, so no more photos can be added. Author only, and only
  once.
